guards.what: BigMushroom's +20 Max HP pickup effect is implemented on the EVENT, not on the relic. BigMushroom.cs:25-29 AfterObtained calls CreatureCmd.GainMaxHp(MaxHpVar 20)
guards.issue: relics/big_mushroom.py has NO after_obtained override -- only modify_hand_draw -- and events/hungry_for_mushrooms.py:32-35 applies the +20 itself right after add_relic. The amount and ordering are right today, so nothing is currently double-applied or dropped: verified by grep that this event is the ONLY grant path in the sim (`grep -rn big_mushroom sts2_rl` outside the relic module returns only events/hungry_for_mushrooms.py:28, 32-33). It is still a divergence in SHAPE at a site where the twin relic in the same event does it correctly, and the relic's own docstring (relics/big_mushroom.py:18-19) justifies it with a false claim -- 'RunState has no run-level AfterObtained dispatch' -- when run.py is exactly that dispatch and FragrantMushroom relies on it. DORMANT, and the concrete thing that would make it live is named: any second grant path for Big Mushroom (a relic reward, a shop, a grab-bag pull) would silently drop the 20 Max HP.

guards.rationale: presentation only -- the option's damage preview. The 15 itself is real and lives on the relic (relics/fragrant_mushroom.py:22), where the source puts it too (FragrantMushroom.cs's HpLossVar).
